title: Library Visits Fell While Digital Checkouts Hit 739 Million
hook: Library buildings emptied while borrowing moved online.
closing: Library readers did not disappear; borrowing followed them onto their phones.
question: How do you borrow library books?

segments.say: Library visits reached 800 million, still well below their earlier peak.
Library digital checkouts reached 739 million, proving borrowing moved online instead of disappearing.
